scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Bubble Buddy, and I'm so glad to see you today. We're going on an amazing underwater adventure about something called emotional regulation. It's a fun way to learn how to feel calm and happy, even when things get a little bumpy. Are you ready to dive in with me? Let's splash into this adventure together and discover how our feelings can be like bubbles, floating gently in the sea!

Now, imagine your feelings are like bubbles floating around you. Sometimes, they can be big and bouncy, like when you're super excited. Other times, they might be small and gentle, like when you're feeling calm. Just like bubbles, our feelings can change shape and size. It's okay to have all kinds of feelings because they are all part of our big ocean of emotions. Let's learn how we can keep our bubbles nice and floaty!

Remember when we talked about bubbles? Well, when a bubble gets too big, it might pop! That's a bit like when we get too upset or angry. But don't worry, we can learn to blow gentle, easy bubbles instead. Let's practice together: take a deep breath in, and slowly blow it out, like you're making a gentle bubble. Great job! This helps keep our feelings soft and floaty, just like the bubbles we love.

Wonderful! You're doing so well. Now let's think about a time when you felt really happy. Maybe it was when you played with a friend or got a big hug. Can you feel that happiness bubble inside you, floating up and up? When we focus on happy bubbles, it helps us feel better and brighter. You can do it, and it's such a fun way to keep our hearts light and joyful!

Let's continue our journey by thinking about what we can do when we feel sad or upset. Sometimes, just like a bubble, we need a little space to float and calm down. You can find a quiet place, close your eyes, and imagine floating gently in the water. This helps our bubbles settle and become peaceful. Isn't it amazing how we can change our feelings just by taking a moment to float and breathe?

Now let's try a fun exercise. Imagine you're a big, strong ship sailing through the ocean. When the waves get high, you can steer your ship carefully to keep it steady. Let's pretend to steer our ships together. Hold your steering wheel tight, take a deep breath, and turn it slowly to the left, then to the right. This helps us stay calm and focused, even when emotions are like big waves!

Great steering, captain! You've got the hang of it. Remember, you can always steer your feelings like a ship. When you feel a big wave of emotion coming, just take a deep breath and steer calmly. It's a superpower you have to make your feelings float gently, just like bubbles in the sea. You're doing such an amazing job, and I'm so proud of you!

Now that we know how to steer our feelings, let's think about how we can share our bubbles with friends. When we talk about our feelings, it's like showing someone our favorite bubble. We can say, 'I'm feeling a little sad today,' or 'I'm really excited!' Sharing helps our friends understand us and makes our bubbles even brighter. Isn't it wonderful to have friends to share our ocean with?

Let's practice sharing our bubbles with a fun game. Think of a feeling bubble you have right now. Is it happy, calm, or maybe a little wobbly? Now, tell me about your bubble, just like you're telling a friend. When we share, it makes our bubbles feel lighter and even more colorful. It's a great way to connect with others and make our ocean of feelings a happy place!

You're doing such a fantastic job sharing your bubbles! Every time you talk about your feelings, you become even more fantastic at emotional regulation. Keep practicing, and soon you'll be an expert at making your feelings float just right. Remember, your feelings are special, and sharing them makes our world a brighter place. You're amazing, and I'm so proud of you!

Do you know what makes your bubbles feel really light and happy? Sometimes it's the little things, like playing a fun game or listening to your favorite story. What are some things that make your bubbles feel good? Maybe it's drawing a picture or singing a song. Can you think of something that fills your bubbles with joy? I'd love to hear all about it!

Those are wonderful ideas! Doing things that make us happy helps our bubbles stay bright and floaty. It's like adding a splash of color to our ocean. Remember, whenever you feel a little down, you can always do something you love to make your bubbles shine again. Isn't it amazing how much power we have over our feelings? You're such a creative and joyful bubble maker!

Let's try one more fun activity to keep our bubbles calm and happy. Imagine a rainbow in the sky, with all your favorite colors. Now, close your eyes and take a deep breath. As you breathe out, imagine you're painting that rainbow in the sky. This helps our bubbles feel colorful and joyful. You can do this anytime you want to feel calm and happy. Isn't that fantastic?

Wow, what beautiful rainbows you're painting! You're doing such an amazing job at keeping your bubbles happy and light. Remember, every time you practice, you get better and better at emotional regulation. You're a bubble champion, and I'm so proud of you. Keep shining bright, and your bubbles will always be full of color and joy!

Now it's time to say goodbye, my little friend. Remember, your bubbles are special, and you have the power to make them float just right. Keep practicing your deep breaths and sharing your feelings with friends. I'm so happy we got to explore the ocean of emotions together. You're a wonderful bubble buddy, and I can't wait to see you next time for more adventures. Bye for now, and keep those bubbles bright!
